title: Approach2: run Neo4j docker import + verify
description: Docker daemon must be running; then run ./approach2-using-existing-graph/scripts/neo4j_up_and_import.sh and verify data in Neo4j Browser (http://localhost:7474).
notes: Ports aligned to 7474/7687 in helper script

title: Approach2: Deterministic risk score + markdown report
description: Implement a deterministic risk-scoring CLI for the Neo4j sample dataset (approach2-using-existing-graph) and generate structured Markdown output (tables, evidence, score breakdown).
acceptance_criteria:
- `python approach2-using-existing-graph/scripts/risk_score_cli.py --type Service --id <id>` prints a Markdown report
- Report includes: resolved entity, evidence counts, relationship map summary, score breakdown table, and top-N evidence tables
- Score is deterministic given the same graph state (stable sorting, integer scoring, no randomness)
- README section 6 updated with usage
close_reason: Implemented deterministic Neo4j-backed risk scoring CLI and updated Approach2 README.

title: Risk Assessment Agent: structured markdown output
description: Update the Risk Assessment Agent instructions to require structured Markdown output (tables) and an explicit deterministic scoring rubric aligned with the CLI.
acceptance_criteria:
- Agent output format specifies Markdown sections and tables
- Sorting/formatting rules documented to reduce variability
- Scoring rubric defined as deterministic integer math with caps/thresholds
close_reason: Updated Risk Assessment Agent instructions for structured Markdown output and deterministic scoring/ordering rules.
